decisions.reason: As a close-to-core product in a growing medical-technology niche, it is likely to be retained while results are still being learned, though its weaker website prominence suggests somewhat higher uncertainty than the others.

This product fits the firm's established hearing-system business and was actively presented at launch, so with organisational slack and no clear sign of underperformance management would likely keep it on the market.
The thermoforming unit supports the firm's integrated workflow offering and uses existing technical and production capabilities, making continuation more likely unless clear shortfalls emerge.
